1: FROM alpine:3.24
2: LABEL maintainer="sig-platform@spinnaker.io"
3: RUN apk --no-cache add --update bash curl openjdk25-jre
4: # Pick up the latest CA bundle and fail the build if the JVM still trusts emSign ECC Root CA - G3.
5: RUN apk --no-cache upgrade && ! keytool -list -cacerts -storepass changeit | grep -qiE 'emsign.*ecc.*g3'
6: RUN addgroup -S -g 10111 spinnaker
7: RUN adduser -S -G spinnaker -u 10111 spinnaker
8: COPY orca-web/build/install/orca /opt/orca
9: RUN mkdir -p /opt/orca/plugins && chown -R spinnaker:nogroup /opt/orca/plugins
10: USER spinnaker
11: HEALTHCHECK CMD curl --fail http://localhost:8083/health
12: CMD ["/opt/orca/bin/orca"]
